title: Ph.D. in Robotics
institution: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI)
about: MBZUAI's Ph.D. in Robotics admits students for Fall 2027. The final application deadline is 15 December 2026 (5 p.m. GST); decisions are due 31 March 2027. Applicants need a bachelor's (CGPA 3.5) or master's (CGPA 3.0); GRE is optional.
requirements: Bachelor's degree with minimum CGPA 3.5 (on 4.0), or master's degree with minimum CGPA 3.0
GRE scores optional for all applicants
Only one application per admission cycle; AED 200 application fee

upskill.name: Robotics & Autonomous Systems II
why: field "Robotics, artificial intelligence" → objective "Foundation models for robotics: RT-2, PaLM-E - language-conditioned robot policies"
field "Robotics" (Ph.D. in Robotics) → objective "Sim-to-real transfer: training in simulation, deploying in the physical world"
Note: the record's stated requirements are academic credentials (CGPA, three referee recommendations), so the match is on the programme's field rather than on listed skills
